cluster.boundary: walls (for-w-i9, r^-9 repulsive on all box faces; no PBC)
cluster.integrator: int-verlet-dmm (Verlet + raw displacement tracking, no moving-average skin adaptation)
cluster.force: for-a-lj-n (single-species LJ 12-6, cutoff + neighbor list, no PBC)
cluster.notes: Confined-box, single-species reference build. Output binary name 'cluster' is shared with the pbc and mav targets -- building one after another silently overwrites the previous binary.

pbc.boundary: pbc (for-w-dummy no-op walls; periodicity controlled by bperx/bpery/bperz in the .3d file)
pbc.force: for-a-lj-n-pbc (single-species LJ 12-6, cutoff, minimum-image PBC, neighbor list)
pbc.neighbor: neighbor-pbc (PBC Verlet list, fixed skin, no adaptive rebuild)
pbc.stopdead: stopdead-m (multi-species-capable, even though this target is single-species)
pbc.notes: No wrt-fpt (no first-passage-time output). Output binary name 'cluster' collides with the cluster and mav targets.

mav.integrator: int-verlet-mav (Verlet + moving-average displacement tracking, adaptive skin radius)
mav.neighbor: neighbor-pbc-mav (PBC, adaptive skin radius via moving-average displacement; per-step diagnostic printed)
mav.stopdead: stopdead (single-species, unlike pbc target which uses stopdead-m)
mav.notes: Output binary name 'cluster' collides with cluster and pbc targets.

mul.thermostat: scalev-m (per-species isokinetic scaling, apth flag gates which species)
mul.force: for-a-lj-n-pbc-m (multi-species LJ 12-6, cutoff, PBC, neighbor list, 1-1/2-2/1-2 mixing)
mul.notes: wrt-xyz-m (plain multi-species XYZ), not the VMD writer.

nuc.neighbor: neighbor-pbc-mav (diagnostics NOT silenced -- verbose per-step neighbor-list prints)
nuc.notes: Same module composition as 'silent' below except neighbor list is verbose (not -DSILENT) and no wrt-fpt.

silent.neighbor: neighbor-pbc-mav-silent (same source as neighbor-pbc-mav.f, compiled with -cpp -DSILENT to suppress per-step diagnostic writes; production build)
silent.notes: Base production build: quiet neighbor list + first-passage-time output.

frenkel.stoddard: stoddard-pbc-n-m-fre (Stillinger + ten Wolde/Frenkel dual cluster criteria)
frenkel.notes: Production build documented as the primary path in docs/CODE_MAP.md call graph. wrt-csi-fre writes both Stillinger (.csi) and Frenkel (.fsi) size distributions.

diffusion.init: init-center (starting cluster centered in box, for diffusion studies)
diffusion.notes: Identical to frenkel except init routine (centered start) and no wrt-fpt.

moviefrenkel.stoddard: stoddard-pbc-n-m-fre-mov (stoddard-pbc-n-m-fre plus cluster movement tracking for visualization)
moviefrenkel.notes: Identical to frenkel except the movement-tracking stoddard variant and no wrt-fpt.

nose.species: multi (Nose-Hoover integrator itself only supports a single active species per docs/CODE_MAP.md)
nose.thermostat: scalev-nh-m (Nose-Hoover coupling; combined with velocity scaling at init)
nose.integrator: int-verlet-nh-mav (Verlet + Nose-Hoover friction terms, iterative velocity/PSI convergence)
nose.notes: Only target using the Nose-Hoover thermostat/integrator pair; requires .3d Q field (v>=1.2).

apple-silent.force: for-a-lj-n-pbc-m-omp (OpenMP-parallel multi-species LJ, PBC, neighbor list)
apple-silent.notes: Module composition matches 'silent' target 1:1, but every hot-path module (neighbor/force/integrator) is the -omp variant; compiled/linked entirely with APPLE_FLAGS (-fopenmp -march=native -ffast-math -funroll-loops -ftree-vectorize) via a target-specific FLAGS override. Bit-identical to 'silent' only below NATOM_PAR_THRESHOLD=2500 per docs/PERFORMANCE.md.

apple-frenkel.notes: Module composition matches 'frenkel' target 1:1 with OMP hot-path modules; APPLE_FLAGS applied via target-specific FLAGS override, same as apple-silent.

rst.notes: wrt-rst-multi writes a uniquely-named restart file per checkpoint instead of overwriting one file; wrt-xyz-m (not VMD).

test.notes: wrt-vel-m-ats1/wrt-xyz-m-ats1 write only species-1 atoms; used for single-species diagnostics of multi-species runs.

benchmark.notes: Not a binary target itself: runs 'make apple-silent && make silent' sequentially (relies on the flag-set-stamp rules to force a clean rebuild between the two, since apple-silent/silent share .o filenames but use incompatible flag sets). Produces both clu-silent-omp and clu-silent for side-by-side comparison.

thinyout.purpose: Downsample an XYZ trajectory by a skip factor.

selats.purpose: Select/color atoms by species for visualization.

selclu.purpose: Color-code atoms by cluster membership, box (non-PBC) variant.

selclup.purpose: Color-code atoms by cluster membership, PBC variant. Shares output name with selclu.

sizer.purpose: Analyze a .csi file: largest-cluster size/temperature time series.

mesher.purpose: Cluster-size-vs-time mesh plot data from .csi file (beta).

pressw.purpose: Pressure from wall forces; non-PBC only; README marks it OBSOLETE.

marker.purpose: Mark specific atoms with alternate symbols.

press.purpose: Average pressure from .ave file over an interval.

density.purpose: Density profile of the largest cluster, box (non-PBC) variant.

densityp.purpose: Density profile, PBC variant. Shares output name with density.

sysdens.purpose: System density on a spatial grid.

colgas.purpose: Track carrier-gas exchange between cluster and vapor, box variant.

colgasp.purpose: Same, PBC variant. Shares output name with colgas.

rdf.purpose: Radial distribution function and structure factor. PBC only (per README).

timefile.purpose: Generate a SciAn time file (ps) from a .3d file.

makelog.purpose: Generate log files (README leaves this undocumented).

bars.purpose: Time-dependent cluster-size-distribution bar chart (.nff) from a .csi file.

reverse.purpose: Reverse time ordering of an XYZ file (README leaves this undocumented).

rate-xyz.purpose: Compute condensation/evaporation rates from an XYZ trajectory.

stotest.purpose: Standalone test harness for the Stoddard cluster routine on XYZ data.

bigcl.purpose: Extract and output only the largest cluster, box variant.

bigclp.purpose: Same, PBC variant. Shares output name with bigcl.

focusclp.purpose: Focus view on a cluster with PBC unwrapping.

tempavg2.purpose: Alternate cluster temperature averaging (variant of tempavg).

housekeeping_targets.clean: Remove all .o files, all MD binaries, and the flag-set stamps.
housekeeping_targets.archive: Tar+gzip the source tree (*.f, *.inc, Makefile, sample.3d, README, helpers/*) into archive.tar.gz.
housekeeping_targets.bdir: Prerequisite of every helper target: creates $(BINDIR) (default $(HOME)/bin) if missing.

thermostat.scalev: Single-species isokinetic velocity scaling (scalev.f, subroutine thermostat).
thermostat.scalev-m: Multi-species isokinetic velocity scaling, gated per species by the apth(i) flag from the .3d file (scalev-m.f). Primary production thermostat.
thermostat.scalev-nh-m: Nose-Hoover coupling combined with velocity scaling at init (scalev-nh-m.f); paired only with int-verlet-nh-mav.
thermostat.scalev-clu: Cluster thermostat (scales cluster atoms separately from vapor); source exists (scalev-clu.f) but is not linked into any Makefile target -- dead in every shipped binary.

boundary.walls: for-w-i9.o (or other for-w-*.f) supplies real repulsive wall forces on box faces; used only by the 'cluster' target.
boundary.pbc: for-w-dummy.o (no-op walls) is linked; periodicity is instead controlled per-axis by the bperx/bpery/bperz fields in the .3d file and enforced by the paired for-a-*-pbc*.f minimum-image force routine and neighbor-pbc*.f neighbor list. Used by every target except 'cluster'.

integrator.int-verlet-dmm: Velocity-Verlet with raw cumulative displacement tracking (no moving-average smoothing) to decide when to rebuild the neighbor list.
integrator.int-verlet-mav: Velocity-Verlet with moving-average displacement tracking and adaptive neighbor-list skin radius. Primary production integrator.
integrator.int-verlet-mav-omp: Same algorithm as int-verlet-mav, OpenMP-parallelized for Apple Silicon builds.
integrator.int-verlet-nh-mav: int-verlet-mav plus Nose-Hoover friction terms and iterative velocity/PSI convergence (up to 1000 iterations, tol 1e-10). Only pairs with scalev-nh-m.
integrator.orphaned (no Makefile target): int-verlet.f (basic Verlet, no displacement tracking), int-euler1.f, int-euler2.f, int-gear3.f, int-gear4.f, int-gear5.f are present in cluster/ and documented in the README but no current Makefile target builds them.

force.for-a-lj-n: Single-species LJ 12-6, cutoff radius, neighbor list, no PBC.
force.for-a-lj-n-pbc: Single-species LJ 12-6, cutoff, neighbor list, minimum-image PBC.
force.for-a-lj-n-pbc-m: Multi-species LJ 12-6, cutoff, neighbor list, PBC; handles 1-1/2-2/1-2 (geometric-mixing) interactions. Primary production force routine.
force.orphaned (no Makefile target): for-a-lj1.f..for-a-lj4.f (O(N^2) historical development sequence), for-a-lj-n-pbcsw.f (shifted-potential PBC), for-a-dummy.f (no-op) exist but are not referenced by any current Makefile target.

neighbor.neighbor: Basic Verlet neighbor list, no PBC.
neighbor.neighbor-pbc: PBC neighbor list, fixed skin, no adaptive rebuild.
neighbor.neighbor-pbc-mav: PBC neighbor list, adaptive skin radius via moving-average displacement tracking; per-step diagnostic printed to stdout.
neighbor.neighbor-pbc-mav-silent: Same source file as neighbor-pbc-mav.f, compiled with 'gfortran -cpp -DSILENT' into a differently-named object (neighbor-pbc-mav-silent.o) that suppresses the per-step diagnostic. Used by every 'production' multi-species target.
neighbor.neighbor-pbc-mav-omp: OpenMP-parallel variant of neighbor-pbc-mav, used by apple-silent/apple-frenkel.
neighbor.orphaned (no Makefile target): neighbor-dummy.f (no-op, for O(N^2) force routines) and neighbor-pbcsw-mav.f (shifted-potential PBC + moving average) exist but are not referenced by any current Makefile target.

stoddard.stoddard: Stillinger cluster search, O(N^2), no PBC.
stoddard.stoddard-pbc: Stillinger cluster search, O(N^2), PBC (used only by helper programs, not by any MD binary target).
stoddard.stoddard-pbc-n: Stillinger cluster search, PBC, neighbor-list-optimized, single-species.
stoddard.stoddard-pbc-n-m: Stillinger cluster search, PBC, neighbor-list-optimized, multi-species.
stoddard.stoddard-pbc-n-m-fre: stoddard-pbc-n-m plus the ten Wolde/Frenkel liquid-monomer cluster criterion. Most complete cluster finder used by an MD binary target.
stoddard.stoddard-pbc-n-m-fre-mov: stoddard-pbc-n-m-fre plus cluster-movement tracking for visualization.
stoddard.orphaned (no Makefile target): stoddard-pbcsw-n.f (shifted-potential variant) and stoddard-dummy.f (no-op) exist but are not referenced by any current Makefile target.

writers.wrt-csi vs wrt-csi-fre: wrt-csi writes only the Stillinger cluster-size distribution (.csi); wrt-csi-fre additionally writes the ten Wolde/Frenkel distribution (.fsi).
writers.wrt-rst vs wrt-rst-multi: wrt-rst overwrites one restart file each interval; wrt-rst-multi writes a uniquely-numbered file per checkpoint.
writers.wrt-xyz family: wrt-xyz (single species, basic), wrt-xyz-m (multi-species), wrt-xyz-m-vmd (multi-species, VMD-compatible, also drives cluster-visualization side files -- used by every 'production' target), wrt-xyz-m-ats1/wrt-vel-m-ats1 (species-1-only output, used by the 'test' target), wrt-xyz1/2/3 and wrt-xyz-m1 (color-coded/largest-cluster/threshold variants used only by helper programs, not by any MD binary target).

Nose-Hoover coupling constant; later rescaled by apmas(1)*apsig(1)^2.

input_3d_fields.unused_reason: Only consumer is scalev-clu.f (subroutine thermostat, cluster-specific scaling), and scalev-clu.o is never linked into any Makefile target -- the field is parsed but has no effect in any shipped binary.

input_3d_fields.meaning: Cluster thermostat timer (steps).
input_3d_fields.unused_reason: Same dead-code path as eclth: only read by scalev-clu.f, which is not linked into any Makefile target.

input_3d_fields.meaning: Target system temperature in Kelvin.
Stillinger cluster-distance criterion, in units of sigma (species-1 sigma); scaled to Angstrom (*atr) after the per-species block is read.
Minimum neighbor count (species 1) for the ten Wolde/Frenkel 'liquid monomer' criterion.
LJ potential cutoff radius, in units of sigma; scaled to Angstrom after the species block.
Neighbor-list skin radius, in units of sigma; scaled to Angstrom after the species block.
Neighbor-list update interval (steps) for the fixed-interval neighbor variants; also seeds the adaptive-skin moving-average window size for the *-mav variants.
Interval (steps) between atom-count-change checks (chgNatom).
Enable nucleation auto-abort check: 'X' = yes, '-' = no.
Minimum cluster size that triggers the nucleation-abort timer.
Number of consecutive timesteps the oversized cluster must persist before the run is aborted.
Number of atom species (fver>=1.10 position); drives the per-species read loop below.

LJ epsilon of species i, in K; converted to internal units (*cikb).

Attractive LJ exponent of species i.

input_3d_per_species_fields.note: Repeats once per species, atsorts times (do i=1,atsorts loop at read-3d.f:229-254), each iteration followed by one blank divider line (read-3d.f:245, 'read (1,\'(A)\') dummy'). sample.3d has 2 species: species 1 on lines 65-75, species 2 on lines 76-85 (same field order).

Repulsive LJ exponent (equivalenced to appr(1)).
Attractive LJ exponent (equivalenced to appa(1)).
Target system temperature in K.
Stillinger cluster-distance criterion, in units of sigma.

input_3d_legacy_pre_1_10_fields.note: This whole block (read-3d.f:208-225) only executes when fver<1.10 -- the old single-species .3d format that predates per-species blocks. It has no corresponding lines in the shipped sample.3d (fver=1.30) and is exercised only by legacy input files that were never migrated.
